title: Rider Add-On to a Closing and Funding Redraw by Property Type
content:
**Term.** The rider add-on of a Closing and Funding redraw is set from the property type on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File: where it is a two-to-four unit property, it is 30.00; where it is a condominium or a townhouse, it is 15.00; otherwise there is none.

| Property type on the Mortgage Loan File | Rider add-on (USD) |
|---|---|
| two-to-four unit property | 30.00 |
| condominium | 15.00 |
| townhouse | 15.00 |
| any other property type (for example a detached single-family home) | none |

Hypothetical: a duplex financed on a Larkspur loan file is a two-to-four unit property, so its redraw carries a 30.00 rider add-on.
